title: Map Snyk transitive dependency remediation for GitPython urllib3 idna

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Started triage for user-reported Snyk fixable transitive findings: gitpython@3.1.49, urllib3@2.6.3, idna@3.11. Next: run snyk CLI and dependency trees to map direct parents and required upgrade paths in this repo.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Findings: local snyk CLI (snyk test --experimental --all-projects) does not currently reproduce gitpython/urllib3/idna findings; it reports other vulnerabilities (for example pypdf) for this workspace snapshot. Dependency mapping confirms lockfile contains gitpython 3.1.49, urllib3 2.6.3, idna 3.11. Parent chains from poetry show --all --tree --why: gitpython <- python-semantic-release (direct dev dependency); urllib3 <- botocore (from direct boto3) and <- requests/modelscope path via paddleocr->paddlex->modelscope; idna <- requests/httpx/anyio/yarl across same chains. All parent version constraints allow upgrades to gitpython 3.1.50, urllib3 2.7.0, idna 3.15. Recommended remediation command: poetry update gitpython urllib3 idna then rerun snyk test/monitor for the same org and target.
